exclusion_source: User-confirmed insufficient information in the face captured by the query photo; NOT a reference-gallery defect.
exclusion_scope: Exclude these 13 query rows only for a secondary sensitivity analysis. Keep the complete reference gallery, identity labels, frozen scoring configurations, and original full1117 results.
identifier_manual_scope: Verified candidate-pair readings are diagnostic hypotheses, not proof of a unique acceptable identity. Append a verified code only when missing from existing query OCR, retaining other lines. Keep reference OCR fixed; separately assess full-code matching. Never count manual readings as deployable accuracy.

automatic_code_match.source: Existing OCR lines inside reviewed human query boxes and reference OCR; no manual codes or test labels supplied to matcher.
automatic_code_match.code_rule: Uppercase alphanumeric segments with at least5 digits, at most4 letters, length5..18; remove separators, preserve order and leading zeros. Reject a repeated single digit. Reference support capped at1% of reference rows.
automatic_code_match.selection: Original selection was made on the then-retained validation set excluding17 and chose weight0. Recalculate the same selection rule on the corrected exclusion13 mask as a sensitivity check only; do not retroactively replace the locked1041 primary or call this a fresh held-out validation.
automatic_code_match.score: Existing final1041 joint score plus weight times binary any-compatible-code score. Missing codes give zero increment. Never remove gallery candidates.
